'''Winter Fete''' is a [[holiday]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It was originally marked the winter equinox on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Pelagon]]. The settlers there were the first to celebrate Winter Fete, and when they began settling other planets in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the holiday went with them. Over time, the holiday was modified to coincide with [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Fete Week]]. In the current Tapani local calendar, Winter Fete fell on the very last week of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]], following the month of [[Welona]].<ref name="LE" />
